title: A replayed request of issues.create has no PHP post-state
review_notes: php_post_state.json loses its req-3 row; receipt.json still asserts php_post_states closed and every other row of the control is present.

Without the post-state gate, issues.create would qualify: req-1 satisfies op_exercised and the omitted req-3 is invisible to php_disagree_any.  With it, op_qualified(issues.create) is unresolved with php_post_state as the missing premise (for req-3); issues.close is supported.
The companion post_state_gap claim is supported from the req-3 request row, replay_requests_closed and php_post_states_closed.

claims.reading: req-1 still agrees on both sides, so op_exercised(issues.create) holds; req-3's PHP post-state is omitted while php_post_states_closed is asserted, so post_state_gap(req-3, php) derives, post_state_any(issues.create) holds and the gate in op_qualified_rt fails.
issues.close (req-2) is fully observed and qualifies as in the control.
replay_request is closed and contains req-3; php_post_states_closed is asserted and no php_post_state(run, req-3, _) exists.
